activity.notes: Gustav II Adolf, commonly known in English as Gustavus Adolphus, reigned as King of Sweden from 1611 until his death at Lützen in 1632. ATLAS uses the Swedish royal canonical form Gustav II Adolf so the already-existing Person identity with the same Korean preferred name can be reused rather than creating a duplicate.

sources.title: The monarchy of Sweden — The Royal Court of Sweden
sources.citation_text: The Royal Court of Sweden lists Gustav II Adolf as reigning from 1611 to 1632.

sources.title: Monarkins historia — Kungahuset
sources.citation_text: The Royal Court describes Gustav II Adolf's reign and records his death at the Battle of Lützen in 1632.
